description:
FILED s473t2 (Opus triage of the 152 causeless blessed sweep rows), on main 0d783d24.
Probe scratch/s473t2/probes/p13-pool.pl B/C/D.
The blessed rows `eval.t 99` and `ref.t 194` have an EMPTY description, and
sweep-diff keys a row on (file, description) -- so each of them stands for ALL
the unnamed failing rows of its file (#1041).  This task holds the shapes.

BEHIND `eval.t 99` (current run: eval.t 21, 22, 26, 94, 95, 96, 98, 99):

1. `eval EXPR` must evaluate EXPR in SCALAR context (eval.t:75-77):
     my @a = qw(a b c d); my @b = eval @a; print "[@b]"
   perl: [4]   (scalar @a is 4, so eval "4")
   PCL : []    and $@ is set: "Undefined subroutine &main::ARRAY called"
   -- PCL evaluates @a in list context and then evals something that is not the
   count.  Rows 21 and 22.

2. An eval inside a sub in package DB sees the CALLER's lexical scope, not the
   sub's (eval.t:356-380 -- the perl-debugger rule):
     our $x = 1; { my $x = 2; sub db1 { $x; eval '$x' }
                   package DB; sub db3 { eval '$x' } package main; }
     { my $x = 3; print db1(), DB::db3(); }
   perl: 2 then 3     PCL: 2 then 2
   Rows 94/95/96/98/99 (db3, db4, db5 and the two GH #19370 spellings).

3. Row 26 is `NS:Context propagation into string eval` (void context reaches the
   eval as scalar: got 'S', expected 'V') -- already a ruled section, listed so
   the collapsed key is fully accounted for.

BEHIND `ref.t 194` (current run: ref.t 109, 117, 118, 196, 197, 198):

4. `local(*bar) = *bar` -- a glob self-alias -- loses the value (ref.t:404-406):
     our $bar = "glob 3"; { local(*bar) = *bar; print $bar }
   perl: glob 3       PCL: (undef)
   Row 118.

5. A `runperl(prog => ...)` child reports its file as `-`, perl reports `-e`
   (ref.t:703-705):
     runperl(stderr => 1, prog => 'map die,4 for 3')
   perl: "Died at -e line 1."     PCL: "Died at - line 1."
   Rows 196/197/198.  This is tools/pclperl-for-tests's program NAME, so it
   affects every `prog =>` child's die/warn location across the whole suite --
   worth fixing at the harness, with a full sweep, because it may move rows in
   several files at once.
   Row 109 is `NS:Indirect object syntax with a SCALAR invocant` and row 117 is
   `NS:Error message text and format` (PCL says "Assigned value is not a SCALAR
   reference" where perl says "Can't modify ... in ... assignment"); listed so
   the collapsed key is fully accounted for.
subject: POOL (s473t2): the shapes behind the COLLAPSED unnamed keys of eval.t and ref.t -- `eval EXPR` is given LIST context, an eval in package DB does not see the caller's pad, `local(*bar) = *bar` loses the value, and a `runperl(prog => ...)` child reports "at - line 1" where perl reports "at -e line 1"
